content: @Matteo Cipollina proposed the idea of having (regular) meetings to collectively go through open-PRs and review them. I believe Mathlib has similar. What do people think? If we do something like this, I think limiting them to 30min at least initially would be a good idea. If people are interested, what sorts of times would work?
(I would also be open to any other ideas how we can make the review process more efficient).
Would these be open meetings? As it would be a good learning opportunity, even though I won't be able to contribute much.
Yeah, they would be open! Anyone can review PRs - it just needs a maintainer to “approve” it. Hopefully we can make these useful as learning opportunities too!
I am likely going to have more spare time in next few months. I can try to review some PRs if it helps.
I would be open to this, but I'm west coast US so usually the times that work best are early mornings for me and late afternoon/evening for most of Europe.
@Jinzheng Li That would be very helpful!
@Daniel Morrison What is the earliest you would be able to do? I was thinking times similar to 2026-05-15T15:30:00+01:00, but I guess even that might be a bit early.

Ok, let me suggest we do the first of these on 2026-05-19T15:30:00+01:00. If this time/day is particularly bad for anyone let me know - if no one turns up, I will just spend the time reviewing any open PRs anyway (obviously people can review outside of this too). Will keep it strictly to 30min.
I would like to attend and understand what PR review entails. Are the times displayed in local timezone? I'm seeing the time of first meeting as 8pm coming Tuesday

Since today's discussion touched upon many points, It would be nice if a summary of key review guidelines discussed can be shared ...
In particular the Kronecker delta example is very important to avoid technical debt and reusable definitions across physics sub-domains.

The review guidelines we have got are: https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib/blob/master/docs/ReviewGuidelines.md. @Daniel Morrison maybe we should link to your Kronecker delta example there?
There was no plan for this, but I'm going to be reviewing PRs for the next 30 min or so - if anyone keen to join, happy to set up a zoom link.
